item.text:
**2B.1 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** the 2024 record does **not** show Khamenei preferring diplomacy and compromise over force as a first resort. There were a few real de-escalation and negotiation signals, but the dominant pattern is escalatory: retaliation after the April strike, celebratory language about military power, and later calls for continued struggle against Israel.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and signaled no retaliation, which Reuters said appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest 2024 de-escalation signal tied to Khamenei’s system. | `2B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `IAEA’s Grossi seeks deal with Iran on nuclear steps ‘soon’` | Reuters | 2024-05-07 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaeas-grossi-seeks-deal-with-iran-on-nuclear-steps-soon-3425312) | After a visit to Iran, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said talks would continue and a package of measures should be reached soon. This shows a live diplomatic channel remained open, but it is indirect evidence of Khamenei choosing compromise. | `2B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran tells IAEA chief it will negotiate but not under pressure` | Reuters | 2024-11-14 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/iran-tells-iaea-chief-it-is-ready-to-negotiate-but-not-under-pressure-x-3722215) | Iran said it was willing to resolve nuclear disputes through negotiation, but only without pressure. This is a weak positive sign for diplomacy, though it is conditional and tactical rather than a clear first-choice compromise posture. | `2B.1`, `1B.4` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike on Israel, said it demonstrated Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This is direct evidence of force being framed as a preferred political instrument. | `2B.1`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | In his first Friday prayer sermon in nearly five years, Khamenei called on regional allies to intensify anti-Israel struggle. This is strong evidence against a diplomacy-first posture in crisis settings. | `2B.1`, `1B.8`, `1B.6` |
| `IAEA Board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors` | Reuters | 2024-06-05 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087) | The IAEA Board called on Iran to reverse its barring of inspectors and improve cooperation. That undercuts any claim that Khamenei’s system was prioritizing peaceful verification over coercive control. | `2B.1`, `1B.4`, `1B.7` |

**Assessment**

- **Best evidence for diplomacy/de-escalation:** the April 19 muted response after the Isfahan incident, plus continued IAEA talks in May and November.
- **Best evidence for force-first behavior:** Khamenei’s April 21 praise for the strike on Israel and his October call for more struggle against Israel.
- **Net reading:** Khamenei’s 2024 conduct looks **force-preferring with limited tactical restraint**, not diplomacy-first when peaceful alternatives existed.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find a strong 2024 primary-source example of Khamenei personally choosing compromise over force when a credible peaceful alternative was clearly on the table.
- The positive evidence is mostly **reactive de-escalation** or **technical negotiation**, while the negative evidence is **direct and public**.
